hero.subtitle: KmerShield evaluates the risk of a link, a message, or an online transaction, and helps you decide what to do next.
hero.reassurance: No PIN or payment password is ever requested.

card.label: Transaction signal
card.title: Full upfront payment demanded
card.signal2Desc: Artificial urgency frequently observed in suspicious deals
card.signal3Desc: Account identifier not associated with any registered entity
card.recDesc: Do not rush into paying. Use an official verification channel or arrange for an in-person exchange.
card.disclaimer: A risk assessment is not proof of fraud. It provides contextual cautionary guidance.

problem.title: Frequent digital pitfalls in informal commerce
problem.subtitle: The rapid growth of peer-to-peer mobile payments exposes users to deceptive solicitations.

card1.title: Fake offers & advance fees
card1.description: Demands for urgent fee transfers for non-existent job offers, parcels, or clearance charges.

card2.title: Impersonation of trusted brands
card2.description: Messages masquerading as official mobile network operators to trick recipients into revealing credentials.

card3.title: Shortened links & mirror pages
card3.description: Deceptive redirects mimicking payment or administrative pages designed to capture personal details.

howItWorks.title: How the evaluation works
howItWorks.subtitle: A transparent three-step workflow to help you make informed decisions in seconds.

step1.title: Submit an item
step1.description: Paste the suspicious link, received message text, or proposed payment arrangement.

step2.title: Heuristic evaluation
step2.description: Our contextual guidelines review the input against known cautionary signals and indicators.

step3.title: Guidance & next steps
step3.description: Receive an intuitive risk rating along with actionable advice before taking any financial action.

howItWorks.note: KmerShield does not execute transfers and does not block payments: the final decision is always yours.

riskLevels.title: Three clear evaluation levels
riskLevels.subtitle: Direct guidance so you can respond with the appropriate level of precaution.

low.label: Low vigilance required
low.description: The analyzed factors do not show evident anomalies. Standard common-sense precautions apply.

moderate.label: Caution recommended
moderate.description: Several atypical indicators were detected. Additional verification is strongly advised.

high.label: Elevated risk detected
high.description: Multiple red flags typical of questionable schemes were identified. Avoid financial commitments.

limits.title: What KmerShield does and does not do
limits.subtitle: An essential ethical boundary to protect trust and independence.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Understand everything regarding the scope and purpose of KmerShield.
faq.a1: No. KmerShield is not an antivirus tool and does not install software on your phone. It is a civic risk evaluation tool designed to assess the contextual risk of links, messages, and transaction scenarios.
faq.q2: Is this service free to use?
faq.a2: Yes, core risk evaluations and educational guidance are completely free for all citizens.
faq.q3: How do you protect my data?
faq.a3: We never ask for or store PINs, passwords, or payment account numbers. Submitted texts are evaluated ephemerally to identify warning patterns without collecting identifiable data.
faq.q4: Does a low risk score guarantee total safety?
faq.a4: No. No automated algorithm can guarantee 100% safety. KmerShield provides an awareness indicator to assist your decision, but cannot replace personal prudence.
faq.q5: What should I do if an elevated risk is detected?
faq.a5: Pause all money transfers or document sharing immediately. Contact the organization via official numbers or opt for an in-person, verified handoff.
